_comment: Copy to sources.manifest.json and list only sources whose terms let us STORE their recipes. Publicly visible is not the same as licensed: most recipe sites' text and photos are copyrighted. Accepted license values: public-domain, CC0, CC-BY-<ver>, CC-BY-SA-<ver>, partner-agreement:<ref>, own. Pages without schema.org NutritionInformation are skipped.

sources.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
sources._verify: USDA asks for attribution, and some MyPlate recipes come from partners. Confirm each partner recipe's terms and that the pages publish nutrition markup before running a full import.
